default.fits: a task whose difficulty, risk and reasoning depth match this configured lane
default.not_for: a task that another listed lane matches more closely

low.fits: a well-understood, mechanical change whose steps a short plan already settles
low.not_for: a change that needs careful reasoning or spans unfamiliar code

medium.fits: a routine change with some ambiguity, where breadth matters more than depth
medium.not_for: a small mechanical change, or an unusually hard and risky one

high.fits: a demanding or ambiguous change that needs careful reasoning across several files
high.not_for: a small mechanical change where speed matters more than depth

xhigh.fits: a hard, open-ended change that needs the deepest reasoning a lane can offer
xhigh.not_for: a small mechanical change where speed matters more than depth

max.fits: a hard, open-ended change that needs the deepest reasoning a lane can offer
max.not_for: a small mechanical change where speed matters more than depth

mixed_not_for: a task that matches none of these variants

other.fits: none of these lanes fits the task
other.not_for: a task that one of the listed lanes covers
